title.en: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office Located in the Municipality of Burgos, Province of Ilocos Norte, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office Located in the Municipality of Burgos, Province of Ilocos Norte, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy tại Đô thị Burgos, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ ในเทศบาล Burgos จังหวัด Ilocos Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: The extension office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) located in the Municipality of Burgos, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby converted into a regular district, to be known as the Burgos LTO District Office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Burgos LTO District Office, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Burgos LTO Extension Office located in the Municipality of Burgos, Province of Ilocos Norte. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
